description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class, which implements the IBasketViewModelService interface. It provides functionality to retrieve or create shopping baskets for users, map basket entities to view models, and count total basket items, using repository and query service dependencies.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for basket-related operations, including retrieval, creation, mapping to view models, and counting items within the basket context.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket entity for a user and returns its view model representation.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Transforms a collection of BasketItem entities into a list of BasketItemViewModels with associated catalog data.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel, including its items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in a user's basket.
